'''A-IDA translator droids''' were a model of [[Droid/Legends|droid]] in use in [[3643 BBY]]. They were employed in [[Tassaa Bareesh]]'s [[Tassaa Bareesh's palace|palace]] on [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]], actig as translators.<ref name="TOR">''[[The Old Republic: Fatal Alliance]]''</ref>
